text:
oncall-bot: Paging on-call: SEV2 elevated 5xx rate from svc-gateway in eu-west-1. Alerts: gateway-handshake-error-rate > 8% over 3m. Triggering runbook: TLS failures suspected. Incident channel opened. @sara you are assigned :rotating_light:

sara: I’m on it. seeing a spike in TLS handshakes failing with error `ssl_handshake_error` at the edge. Metrics: 8.9% 5xx, p50 latency up ~200ms. Starting tcpdump on the edge node pool.

infra-ops: grabbing recent certs from cert-manager and rotator logs. Quick check: leaf cert for svc-gateway-eu appears to have a mismatch against CA bundle published 03:15 UTC. Not yet sure if it's expired or untrusted.

kevin: I can run a quick curl against the gateway to see client-side error. Running: `curl -v https://svc-gateway.eu-west-1.redwood.ai/health`

kevin: curl output: "SSL: certificate subject alt name does not match target host name" followed by: "peer certificate cannot be authenticated with known CA certificates". Also seeing `handshake_failure` in client logs.

maria: Support reporting that a handful of customers in EU are seeing 502/504 on generation requests. One high-value customer, AlphaApps, reporting degraded calls since 03:12 UTC. I’ve opened a support ticket and informed account team.

sara: tcpdump + sni logs show clients present SNI for svc-gateway.eu-west-1 but edge is serving a leaf cert issued to `svc-gateway.internal` (internal hostname). Looks like the wrong cert was mounted to the edge nginx instance after recent rotation. Not expired, but hostname mismatch -> handshake failure.
support-liaison: Confirming impacted routes: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings for eu-west-1. Non-EU regions unaffected. Estimated 12k requests/min with ~9% errors.
infra-ops: rotator logs at 03:10 UTC show an automated rotation job that attempted to rotate to new cert bundle. It logged success but the certificate distributor returned a 202 accepted and then later an error from the distributor. Looks like partial rollout: some nodes got new bundle, others still on older one.
kevin: For quick mitigation we can pin the edge to the previous known-good cert (rollback) or configure the gateway to present the intermediate CA that will validate both certs temporarily. Which is faster?

sara: Rolling back the cert distributor to previous bundle is fastest. I’ll issue distributor rollback to the last-good bundle id `bundle-2026-03-14-1310`. Taking care to only target eu-west-1 edge pool.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by sara: cert-distributor rollback -> bundle-2026-03-14-1310 to edge-pool-eu-west-1. CI checks passed. ETA ~ 90s per node, rolling.

infra-ops: Adding a bypass rule at the load balancer to route alpha-customer traffic to a healthy node set with verified certs while rollback completes. This will protect AlphaApps immediately.

kevin: Adding verification script to confirm TLS subject matches SNI across pool: ```#!/bin/bash
for n in $(cat eu_nodes.txt); do
  echo $n
  openssl s_client -servername svc-gateway.eu-west-1 -connect $n:443 -showcerts </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates
done
```

sara: Rollback completed to 30% nodes, seeing handshake failure rate drop from 9% -> 2.1% in 2m. Continuing rollout.

maria: Notifying AlphaApps support rep: temporary mitigation applied and rollback in progress. Asking them to verify.

AlphaApps (via support ticket): Confirmed routing to healthy nodes; after a few retries errors dropped. Thanks.

sara: Rollback finished across all eu-west-1 nodes at 03:34 UTC. Post-rollback metrics: 5xx down to 0.8%, latency back to baseline. Marking immediate mitigation complete.

infra-ops: Investigating why distributor reported 202 accepted but deployed wrong cert. Early suspicion: cert bundling script included internal cert in the bundle due to path mis-join in release job. File: `scripts/pack_cert.sh` had a fallback to `certs/*.pem` which picked internal cert prior to filtering.

kevin: I’ll open a PR to add stricter validation in pack_cert.sh and add a preflight that verifies SAN matches expected SNI and CA chain. Will also add a canary rollout flag in distributor to prevent partial ambiguous success.

eng-sre: Creating incident report draft. Need timeline, customer impact, mitigation, and followups: 1) Fix pack_cert.sh and CI preflight, 2) Add distributor acceptance checks, 3) Add canary rollout config, 4) Postmortem review with oncall and support.

sara: Handoff to night oncall at 04:00 UTC in 10m. I'll leave notes in the incident doc and set priority to follow-up. If errors reappear escalate to SEV1.

oncall-bot: Handoff: sara -> eng-sre (night). Incident marked as mitigated, follow-up required. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem details and customer comms. :white_check_mark:

eng-sre: Acknowledged handoff. I’ll finalize the incident report and coordinate the postmortem. Thanks everyone for fast response.

support-liaison: Logged customer impact summary: ~45 customers affected briefly, 3 with elevated SLA risk, AlphaApps noted. Drafting customer-facing note for customers with incidents.

oncall-bot: Incident closed for paging at 04:12 UTC. Follow-up task created: TASK-4521 "Review cert bundling & distributor canary" assigned to kevin/sara.
